comune.errore_generico: Something went wrong. Please try again.
barra.offline: Offline: everything is saved on this device and sent as soon as the connection is back.
barra.aggiornamento: A new version of the app is ready.
barra.ricollega: The connection to Plexus is no longer valid. Go to settings to reconnect the app.
eventi.nessuno_testo: Create the first event to start collecting contacts at the stand.
evento.note_segnaposto: Hall, stand number, who is there…
evento.ringraziamento_aiuto: If on, {{piattaforma}} immediately sends a thank-you email to every contact with an email address.
evento.questionario_aiuto: The closed questions you will ask visitors. One of them is the consent to communications.
evento.consenso_aiuto: The first answer counts as "Yes", the second as "No".
evento.traduzione_opzioni: Translated answers, same order (one per line)
evento.categorie_aiuto: The labels the stand staff can assign to a contact with one tap.
evento.errore_date: The last day cannot be before the first.
evento.errore_opzioni: Every question needs a text and at least two answers.
evento.errore_traduzione: Translated answers must be as many as the original ones.
evento.errore_consenso_doppio: Only one question can be the consent question.
dettaglio.cerca: Search by name, company, email, city…
dettaglio.nessuna_lead_testo: Tap "New contact" to register the first visitor.
lead.lingua_aiuto: The questionnaire and the emails will be in this language.
lead.note_segnaposto: E.g. wants the price list, call back on Monday…
lead.foto_aiuto: Business card, face to match the name, other. Archive only: no automatic recognition.
lead.errore_minimo: Enter at least a first name, last name or email.
lead.errore_email: The email does not look right.
lead.errore_salvataggio: Could not save. Please try again.
lead.al_visitatore: You can hand the device to the visitor
lead.scelta_multipla: You can choose more than one answer
lead.elimina_conferma: Delete this contact from the device? If it already reached {{piattaforma}}, it stays there.
lead.solo_lettura: This contact was added from {{piattaforma}}: edit it there.
lead.foto_troppo_grande: The photo exceeds {{mb}} MB even after resizing.
lead.foto_elimina_conferma: Delete this photo from the device?
lead.annulla_conferma: Leave without saving? The data entered will be lost.
visitatore.saluto_aiuto: They help us send you only the information you care about.
impostazioni.plexus_aiuto: Paste the {{piattaforma}} address and the personal code created in {{piattaforma}} → Event leads → Stand lead app → Connect a device.
impostazioni.scollega_conferma: Disconnect {{piattaforma}}? Data stays on the device and unsent contacts will be sent again when you reconnect.
impostazioni.posta_non_pronta: Mailbox for thank-you emails not configured in {{piattaforma}}: emails stay pending
impostazioni.token_revocato: The code is no longer valid (revoked or expired). Create a new one in {{piattaforma}} and paste it here.
impostazioni.permesso_negato: The connected account is not allowed to manage leads in {{piattaforma}}.
impostazioni.errore_url: Enter a full address starting with https://
impostazioni.errore_https: For safety the connection must use https:// (http:// is allowed only locally).
impostazioni.errore_403: The account is not allowed to manage leads.
impostazioni.errore_rete: Cannot reach {{piattaforma}}. Check the address and the network.
impostazioni.dati_aiuto: Everything stays on this device until you delete it. No data goes to third parties.
impostazioni.installa_aiuto: From Safari: Share → "Add to Home Screen". From Chrome/Android: menu → "Install app".
evento.errore_opzioni_doppie: A question has two identical answers.
evento.errore_consenso_opzioni: The consent question must have exactly two answers (yes and no).
evento.annulla_conferma: Leave without saving? The changes to the event will be lost.
lead.bozza_ripristinata: I recovered the data you were entering.
report.pronto_testo: The file is ready. You can share it (AirDrop, email, WhatsApp…) or download it to the device.
report.condividi_non_disponibile: Sharing is not available on this device: download the file.
evento.archivia_conferma: Archive the event? It disappears from the list (here and in {{piattaforma}}) but nothing is lost: you will find it among the archived ones and can reopen it.
evento.archiviato_avviso: This event is archived: it no longer appears in the main list.
evento.rimuovi_conferma_uno: Remove the event and its contact from this device? They stay in {{piattaforma}}. Check first that everything has been sent.
evento.rimuovi_conferma_molti: Remove the event and its {{n}} contacts from this device? They stay in {{piattaforma}}. Check first that everything has been sent.
evento.rimuovi_bloccato: There is still data to send to {{piattaforma}}: wait for the sync before removing.
impostazioni.api_vecchia: This {{piattaforma}} has API {{versione}}: archiving, photos shared between devices and editing of events born in {{piattaforma}} require 1.1.
